passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: The park is nearby, and I go there often.
phrases.ko: 공원은 우리 집 가까이에 있고, 나는 자주 가요.

phrases.en: There are many trees, and the grass is green.
I sit on a bench and watch a bird.
I walk on the path with my little sister.
I see a flower, and I play on the swing.
The green grass is soft under my shoes.
A bird sings in the tree.
My brother plays ball along the path.
phrases.ko: 오빠는 길을 따라 공을 가지고 놀아요.

phrases.en: We like this park because it is nearby.
I rest on the bench when I am tired.
The park is my favorite place after school.
phrases.ko: 공원은 방과 후에 내가 가장 좋아하는 곳이에요.
